title: Financial Inclusion via FinTech: From Digital Payments to Platform Investments
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. Main regressions relate mutual-fund participation/risk-taking to a continuous FinTech-adoption measure (logalicnt) with user and month FE and time-varying controls; identification uses distance-to-Hangzhou IV (Table 3) and a single-date Shenzhen QRPay event (Table 4: post = report_month >= 201704, sz x post with controls and month FE only). Shipped data are synthetic per README.
design_notes: Package mnsc.2024.04423/: 0.Readme.docx and 0.Readme.xlsx, Tables.do (Stata; Tables 2-9), Fig1/Fig3/Fig4 Python, Fig2_PanelB.m (Matlab), synthetic .dta files (panel.dta, ant50000.dta, table3_panela/b.dta, table6.dta, table7.dta, table8_panela/b.dta, table9_login.dta). README: 'All data and code provided ... are synthetic and do not reproduce the original results' (Ant Group NDA).
